title: Containers & Architecture
blurb: Understand kernel namespaces, cgroups, images versus containers, OCI standards, and the Docker daemon architecture.

title: Container Operations & CLI
blurb: Master everyday container lifecycle commands, interactive execution, log inspection, port mapping, and resource cleanup.

title: Images, Layers & Registries
blurb: Work with read-only image layers, tags, digests, Docker Hub, GHCR, and production image tagging strategies.

title: Building Images & Dockerfiles
blurb: Write robust Dockerfiles with WORKDIR, COPY, RUN, CMD, ENTRYPOINT, build context, ARG, and ENV.

title: Data Persistence & Storage
blurb: Persist data across container lifetimes using named volumes, bind mounts, tmpfs, and backup strategies.

title: Container Networking
blurb: Connect containers using default bridges, user-defined networks with automatic DNS, host networking, and port binding.

title: BuildKit, Caching & Multi-Stage
blurb: Speed up builds and shrink image size with layer caching, multi-stage builds, Distroless images, cache mounts, and buildx.

title: Multi-Container Apps with Compose
blurb: Define and orchestrate multi-service applications using Compose Specification files, networks, healthchecks, and profiles.

title: Container Hardening & Security
blurb: Protect containerized workloads with non-root users, dropped capabilities, vulnerability scans, and read-only filesystems.

title: Logging, Inspection & Observability
blurb: Troubleshoot crashing containers, configure healthchecks, set resource limits, and collect logs, metrics, and traces.

title: CI/CD & Production Deployment
blurb: Automate container pipelines with GitHub Actions, publish to GHCR, and implement rolling, blue-green, and canary deployments.

title: Orchestration, Kubernetes & IaC
blurb: Explore container orchestration, Kubernetes pods and deployments, kubectl, declarative IaC, and end-to-end production operations.
